title: Villager
_note: Gossip that follows the story. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

idle.text: Hot one today. They say it'll be hotter tomorrow. They always say that.

haddads.text: You hear about the Haddads? Just gone. The collector says a debt. Hamza Haddad never owed a copper in his life.

burned.text: [They look at the brand showing at your collar, and then they don't.] I'm sorry about your farm. I'm sorry. I have to go.

tarik.text: Someone did the Collector on the east road. Nobody's paying the tax this week. Nobody knows who to pay. [Quieter.] They're saying it was a ghost.

bahram.text: The Hammer's dead. The Hammer. At the old stair. People are saying a farmer did it. [They look at you.] Well. Good.

a1.text: Kesh riders came asking about a farmer with a brand. Nobody knew anything. Funny, that. Nobody ever does.
